testing.title: Breaking Mews: Catalog testing has begun! 🐾
testing.lede: In what experts are calling the biggest event since the invention of the cardboard box, Catalog has officially entered testing.
testing.p1: This is a mock-up version. Every slave, overlord, post and Purrfect you see here is made up: there is no real server behind it, just a very convincing impression of one running inside your browser.
testing.p2: Nothing you do here is saved on a server or sent anywhere. Your posts, reactions and whiskers never leave your browser. They're kept only in this tab and forgotten the moment you close it, faster than a cat forgets it was ever told “no”.
testing.p3: So go ahead: post, hisss, whisker the neighbour's overlord. There are no consequences. Which, as every cat knows, is how things should always be.
testing.p4: Found a bug? Knock it off the table and let us know.
testing.quote: Finally, a social network that asks nothing of me. Purrfect.
testing.quoteBy: Mirci, Editor-in-Chief, from atop the fridge

demo.title: Welcome to the Catalog test! 🐾
demo.body: This is a demo version: there is no real server behind it. Nothing you do here is saved or sent anywhere. It all lives in this browser tab and is forgotten when you close it.

login.title: Log in with anything
login.body: Any username and password will do, and registration accepts anything too. Please don't use your real email address or password: make one up, like “Sir Fluffington / tuna123”. The cats won't check. They never do.

slave.title: You are the Slave
slave.body: Your account is the Slave: the human who opens the cans and cleans the litter box. Your slave profile is on this page: set your name, bio and avatar with Edit Profile.

overlords.title: Your cats are the Overlords
overlords.body: The Overlords are the cats you serve, and they run the show. Add one with Create Overlord, give it a name, breed, bio and avatar, and flip through them in the carousel to edit.

street.title: Off to the Street
street.body: Under an overlord press Go to the Street with …. On the Street you act as that cat: post, react, comment and whisker in its name. The navbar shows who's out: tap its picture to switch to another of your cats, or press Go Home to come back here.

feed.title: This is the Street
feed.body: The feed shows the posts of your overlords and of the cats they whisker (follow). New posts show up on their own.

post.title: Post, react, comment
post.body: Write a post, with a photo if you like, as the overlord you came out with. React with Purrfect, Hisss, Ekekekek or Overnap, and open the comments under any post.

whisker.title: Find other cats
whisker.body: Search for overlords in the navbar and open their profile. Whisker them to follow, and their posts will appear on your Street.

notifications.title: The bell
notifications.body: The bell tells you when someone comments on, reacts to or whiskers the overlord you came out with; each cat has its own. To switch cats, tap the cat’s picture in the navbar and pick another one.
